name: GMD Egyptian inspiration graphics batch 2 — selected studies
classification: Eight original vector studies that abstract visible source components; not direct tracings. Source photos are retained, linked and cropped for comparison.

assets.construction: A large almost-circular field narrows into a two-bend tail and ends in a small return loop. Leave the interior empty; all Arabic copy in the source is excluded.
assets.classification: source-informed contemporary adaptation; not a direct tracing or historical reconstruction
assets.usage: Editorial pull-quote field with live HTML text positioned separately; not a speech icon or call-to-action by default.
assets.minimumUse: 320 px wide; 24 px text inset minimum.

repeat.method: No repeat claim; inspect as a bounded composition.

assets.construction: Sixteen equal angular sectors share one center. Eight straight three-point V chords per sector alternate their apex direction between adjacent wedges; each sector has a nested rim triangle. A narrow tapering handle carries diamond cells. Two mesh ovals attach above and below the handle near the hub. Sector count and spacing are a contemporary measured approximation.
assets.classification: source-informed contemporary adaptation; not a direct tracing or historical reconstruction
assets.usage: Large editorial seal/diagram focal; the source uses a figurative image at the hub, so this study intentionally leaves that center open.

repeat.method: No repeat claim; inspect as a bounded composition.

assets.construction: A strong vertical edge rail balances a sparse center; one oblique route crosses a dotted field; four short waves sit near the index; a blank square plate anchors the opposite corner. Source text and picture are not recreated.
assets.classification: source-informed contemporary adaptation; not a direct tracing or historical reconstruction
assets.usage: Archive object or chapter opener composition; replace plate with approved image and keep copy as HTML.
assets.minimumUse: 320 px wide; maintain 16 px copy-safe rail inset.

repeat.method: No repeat claim; inspect as a bounded composition.

assets.construction: A two-column/two-row dot cell is spaced on a 16 by 16 unit lattice. The source is an irregular printed halftone photograph; this clean periodic dot matrix is a contemporary regularization, not a facsimile.
assets.classification: source-informed contemporary adaptation; not a direct tracing or historical reconstruction
assets.usage: Bounded peripheral field; never behind small text. The SVG contains a verified 16x16 translation cell.
assets.minimumUse: Use at 96 px tile scale or larger; dots must remain >=1.2 px.

repeat.method: Exact 16x16 translation cell (dot centers repeat by identical x/y vector)
repeat.edgeTest: Source code defines pattern width/height 16 with identical cells under integer 16-unit translations.

assets.construction: One angular bird-like contour captures the source’s rising triangular wing, narrow neck/head, small eye, long beak and sweeping body. A broad crossing curve, nested opening, irregular mesh lozenge, wire triangle constellation, and scattered marks retain the contrast between bold silhouette and thin linework. Contemporary adaptation; not a site or species claim.
assets.classification: source-informed contemporary adaptation; not a direct tracing or historical reconstruction
assets.usage: Large conceptual editorial illustration or chapter title plate; keep explanatory text outside the contour.
assets.minimumUse: 300 px tall; maintain fine-grid region >=100 px.

repeat.method: No repeat claim; inspect as a bounded composition.

assets.construction: Rectangular picture aperture with orthogonal double rule. Each corner continues into a double-loop return. Two unequal hand-drawn burst marks interrupt the top rail. The portrait and Arabic nameplate remain absent.
assets.classification: source-informed contemporary adaptation; not a direct tracing or historical reconstruction
assets.usage: Replaceable portrait/photo frame; preserve the original image route and focal controls outside this SVG.
assets.minimumUse: 240 px tall; clear window >=65% of inner width.

repeat.method: No repeat claim; inspect as a bounded composition.

assets.construction: A horizontal field of parallel fine rules supports one long angular connector that turns around an open hub. Three small right-aligned stage windows repeat a reduced zig-zag/bridge silhouette. This reproduces the composition logic, not the source illustration or typography.
assets.classification: source-informed contemporary adaptation; not a direct tracing or historical reconstruction
assets.usage: Technical explainer, process overview, or editorial section transition. Keep explanatory labels separate.
assets.minimumUse: 340 px wide; each stage window >=48 px wide.

repeat.method: No repeat claim; inspect as a bounded composition.

assets.construction: Three different-sized concentric disks sit off-axis; alternating outlined/filled triangles form two broken zig-zag bands; sparse dots bridge the bands while an intentionally open center keeps space for source imagery or title. Figurative symbols and lettering in the source are not redrawn.
assets.classification: source-informed contemporary adaptation; not a direct tracing or historical reconstruction
assets.usage: Large bounded campaign texture behind illustration only; keep the central title/image field legible.

repeat.method: No repeat claim; inspect as a bounded composition.
